parameters.content:
## 🛒 Cart Abandonment Recovery
**Cart abandoned → timed reminder → sale recovered.**

### Setup (about 12 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → `storeName`, `fromEmail`, `checkoutUrl`.
2. Send a POST to the Production URL when someone reaches checkout and
   does not complete. Minimum payload:
   ```json
   { "email": "...", "cartId": "...",
     "items": [...], "total": 49 }
   ```
3. **Also** send `{"email":"...","event":"purchased"}` when they buy —
   this is what stops the sequence.
4. Attach SMTP. Activate.

⚠️ **Step 3 is not optional.** Without it you will email people about a
cart they already paid for, which is worse than sending nothing at all.

### 💸 Why discounting is OFF by default
The obvious build offers a discount straight away. It is a trap.

Buyers learn quickly that abandoning a cart produces a coupon — so you
end up **paying a discount on sales you would have made at full price**,
and you train your best customers to always abandon first.

This sends a plain reminder first. The incentive appears only on the
final message, and only if you set `enableDiscount: true` yourself.

**Try it with discounts off for a month.** Most stores recover more than
they expect on the reminder alone.

### ⏱️ The sequence
| When | Message |
| --- | --- |
| +1 hour | "You left something behind" |
| +24 hours | Last reminder *(+ discount if enabled)* |
| — | **Stop.** |

**Two messages, hard cap.** A third converts almost nobody and reliably
produces spam complaints — which damage the sending reputation that every
other template here depends on.

### ⚠️ Honest expectations
Recovery rates for digital products typically land in the **single digits
to low teens**. Anyone promising 30% is selling something.

At a 5% recovery rate on 100 carts of $49, that is ~$245/month from a
template you configure once. That is the real case — not a miracle, just
money that was otherwise left on the table.

nodes.name: 🛒 Cart event
nodes.notes: Accepts abandonment events and {"event":"purchased"} to stop a sequence.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: enableDiscount is false on purpose. Read the green note before turning it on.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 📝 Track the cart
nodes.notes: Opens/updates a cart, or closes it on purchase. Adding items never restarts the clock.

nodes.name: ↩️ 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer fast so the provider does not retry on timeout.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config (schedule side)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Mirror of the main Config. Change one, change both.

nodes.name: 🔍 Find carts due a reminder
nodes.notes: Two messages then the cart is retired. The cap is enforced here.

nodes.name: ✍️ Compose the reminder
nodes.notes: Discount block only renders when enableDiscount is true AND it is the final message.

nodes.name: 📈 Recovery summary
nodes.notes: Optional. Wire to Slack/Sheets if you want a running record.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle failure
nodes.notes: Structured failure record. Wire to your alert channel.
